title: Bentham's 'nonsense upon stilts' is not quoted from a verified edition
summary: The opposing line is famous and was not checked against Anarchical Fallacies in this pass.
body: Natural-rights critics often quote Jeremy Bentham calling them nonsense upon stilts, from Anarchical Fallacies, against the French declaration. The line was not opened in a verified copy here. Do not retrieve it as a checked quotation. The disagreement it stands for is real: one side treats rights as prior to the state, another treats them as legal creations. The sourced documents are the Declaration, the French declaration, the UDHR, and Murphy's encyclopedia entry.
said_by: commonly attributed to Jeremy Bentham; not verified here
